mechanism_narrative: EGFR+FGFR1 forced proximity via rigid_helix_40 (~60 Å) linker biases signaling toward GRB2-SHC1-FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 adaptor complexes, activating MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways while sterically excluding PLCG1/2 (Ca2+ signaling) and CBL (EGFR downregulation). The biased output upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) and downregulates aged-muscle IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) and myogenic stress markers (MYF5, MYH9), consistent with a rejuvenating shift from aged fibroblast/MuSC toward a young muscle phenotype.
